cold_start_experiment.question: is cold start one regime or several?
cold_start_experiment.protocol: 10 runs, 1 cold-start measurement per run per mode; Chrome data wiped between runs with `pm clear com.android.chrome`; fixed performance mode on
cold_start_experiment.note: pipeline build for fused reports "<1 ms" and is recorded as such, not as 1.0

session_cold.caveat: observed once per mode in the first 3x5 run; never deliberately reproduced

cold_start_experiment.finding: clearing Chrome data does not reproduce the 35 ms figure (7.1 ms with wipe vs 7.6 ms without), so the shader cache is NOT the cause; the ~35 ms is GPU-process and driver bring-up below Chrome storage, paid about once per session
cold_start_experiment.retracts: the earlier README claim that Chrome shader-cache persistence explained the 35.6 -> 7.6 ms drop
